title: Pathogenic review: Damn, it feels good to be a virus
summary: The game definitely has more than a little cell-stage Spore in it. Between runs, you’ll spend the game’s meta-currency (mostly obtained from bosses) to unlock permanent upgrades on a skill tree, making subsequent runs a bit smoother.
